function: Extrapolation of channel fingerprints (location-indexed statistical CSI, beam-domain power distribution) between frequency bands via image-to-image translation, to assist CSI acquisition and precoding (pp. 1, 4-5).
system: Multi-band massive MIMO downlink: BS with co-located UPAs (8x8 at 2 GHz; 10x10 to 15x15 at 5-24 GHz), single-antenna UTs; no RIS (pp. 3, 8).
method: Supervised paired image-to-image translation: residual encoder-decoder CNN pair (CF-CGN) trained jointly with MSE loss plus variable-weight cycle-consistency loss; refining by grid-to-pixel conversion and pooling (pp. 5-7).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa channels, LOS and NLOS; 32x32 m region, 2 m grids, 364 time slots per grid; default f1 = 2 GHz, f2 = 5 GHz (p. 8).
test_conditions: Evaluated separately for LOS, NLOS, f2 of 3.6, 5, 24 GHz, and M2 from 10x10; no train-in-one, test-in-another condition is reported (pp. 9-10).
baselines: Non-learned linear extrapolation [53]; learned CycleGAN [48]; ablations CF-CGN without cycle loss and without refining; sum-rate upper bound with perfect CSI (pp. 9, 11).
metrics: NMSE in dB of the extrapolated fingerprints; sum rate with robust precoding versus SNR; parameters, FLOPs, and memory (pp. 8, 11-12).
complexity: CF-CGN 126.47 M parameters, 5.71 G FLOPs, 29.65 MB; CycleGAN 184.64 M, 15.57 G, 48.25 MB; convolution time and space orders given (p. 12).
openness: none (no code or data link; datasets are generated with the QuaDRiGa simulator, p. 8)
q1_support: p. 8: "The datasets are generated by QuaDRiGa [52]" (LOS and NLOS scenarios).
q2_support: p. 9: "To further validate its generalization ability, we conduct experiments to evaluate the NMSE performance with different numbers of antennas and various frequencies" - no statement that a model trained in one configuration is tested in another; its channels follow the antenna numbers (p. 8: input tensors 32x32x100 and 32x32x64), so retraining per configuration is implied.
q3_support: p. 9: "the linear extrapolation-based method [53] and CycleGAN-based algorithm [48] are adopted as benchmarks" - the first is traditional, the second a standard architecture applied to the same task; both compared on NMSE (Table IV) and sum rate (Fig. 7, p. 11).
q4_support: p. 12: "Table V gives the specific numerical results of parameters, floating point operations (FLOPs), and memories" - CF-CGN 126.47 M, 5.71 G, 29.65 MB.
q5_support: p. 8: "The datasets are generated by QuaDRiGa [52]" - own simulated data with a simulator, not a public dataset; the paper gives no link to code or data.
notes: PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint (2412.20885v1) titled 'CF-CGN: Channel Fingerprints Extrapolation for Multi-band Massive MIMO Transmission based on Cycle-Consistent Generative Networks'; the DOI is not printed in it, matched by topic and venue. Area 2: fingerprint extrapolation is statistical-CSI synthesis across bands (p. 1); the sum rate with a classical robust precoder [58] is only a downstream check (p. 11); the reviewer may confirm that a channel knowledge map is not an excluded radio-map or spectrum function. q2 is borderline: the paper claims generalization (pp. 1, 9) but reports no cross-condition test. q1 rests on QuaDRiGa, which the rule lists. Table I gives f2 as 3.9, 5, 24 GHz while p. 9 says 3.6, 5, 24 GHz.
